profile.headline: Lab Technician at Pro Image Photo
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Born in Long Island, NY in 1991, Cliff Lee creates drawings, digital programs, and photographs, which convey personal narratives within the context of sociological phenomena. He earned his BFA in Art in Technology at Allegheny College. Currently, he works in Queens, NY.

His body of work can be seen at cliffleeart.com

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Redesign overhaul of 18 year-old e-commerce website, transferred 1000+ product database over to Wordpress/Woocommerce content managing system, relaunched home, blog, and product pages, streamlined customer experience to 2022 web standards of automated email replies, customer forms, and charges.

positions.title: Photo Laboratory Technician
positions.description:
Lab Technician at the Amsterdam Location for Pro Image Photo located in New York, NY.

Duties include Film development (C-41, Black and White, 120 and 35mm), Film scanning, Chromogenic print development, Restoration work, product knowledge, and customer service and satisfaction.

Software used: Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Lightroom, Adobe InDesign, Kodak and Dakis Print Ordering Systems, Business Professional Cash Operation System.

Hardware used: Noritsu QSS-3704 (Chromogenic Printing), Noritsu QSF-V30 (C-41 Film Development), Noritsu QSS-3312 (Film scanning and printing), Epson V850 Pro (Film and Print Scanning), Mac and PC OS proficiency.

positions.title: Project Coordinator
positions.description: Assisting in the development of 3D architectural renderings, animations, and virtual reality experiences, coordinating architectural, landscaping, and interior design information, retouching marketing images, ensuring accurate, color corrected materials.

positions.title: Project Assistant
positions.description: Assisting in the development of architectural graphics and presentations for real estate marketing, offering support in all phases of the design process

positions.title: Program Coordinator/Photography and Digital Media Specialist
positions.description: Coordinating with program facilitators on the progression of lesson plans and projects, teaching photography and video production to middle school students, leading digital media projects that concern social action/justice

positions.title: Photography/Digital Media Facilitator
positions.description: Teaching photography and video production to 6th through 8th grade students, leading students in digital media projects that concern social action/justice, developing curriculum for after-school programming.

positions.title: Administrative/Production Assistant Intern
positions.description: Working with the artist in creating photo-conceptual artwork, scanning, editing, printing, and archiving images for the artist's solo exhibition.

positions.title: Gallery Assistant Intern
positions.description:
General, Directorial, Sales, and Registrar Assistance 

Responsible for creating client presentations using Adobe Photoshop and Microsoft Word, the upkeep of edition books, input and research for new website preparations, tracking and storing press articles, framing and photography assistance, and social media updates, assisted with general sales inquiries, and served as the artist liaison for biography updates.

positions.title: Computer Art Studio Assistant
positions.description: Printing photographs and digital illustrations using large format printers, maintaining printers, computers, and scanners, assisting students with troubleshooting and digital art making concerns.

positions.title: Gallery Assistant
positions.locationName: The Bowman~Penelec~Megahan Art Galleries of Allegheny College
positions.description: Working with a curator and other assistants on the execution of exhibitions, cataloguing inventory, setting up and hanging installation work, traditional media, and digital media, creating promotional materials.

positions.title: Studio Assistant Intern
positions.description:
-Prepared images for digital feeds
-Assisted in the management of an artist's inventory of artwork.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
-Collaborated with artists/computer scientists to complete a grant proposal
-Designed drafts for a smart-phone app and a printed brochure displaying scientific visuals
-Designed promotional materials

positions.title: Distribution Intern
positions.description: Assisting the head of distribution of a not-for-profit arts newspaper, organizing data to facilitate the process of distribution, promoting the newspaper at concerts and events

positions.title: Children's Mentor
positions.description:
-Facilitated art classes that concerned environmental exploration
-Assisted in the supervision and instruction of youths at a community program
-Interacted with youths in various group play activities
